defect: is_dyn_method and lookup_impl_method_query count only `generic_params.type_or_consts.len()` and omit `generic_params.lifetimes.len()` when computing `trait_params` to split `fn_subst`, miscalculating `fn_params` or underflowing on traits with lifetime parameters.
Module::import_source_impl returns `TreeArc<ast::PathSegment>` by unwrapping the last path segment of a use tree, panicking on glob imports (`use foo::*;`) which have no final path segment.
expand_eager_macro_input retains unused token IDs in the remapped eager input token map after expanding nested macros, corrupting token-to-source mapping.

highlight_element classifies every `T![-]` token under `ast::PrefixExpr` as `HighlightTag::NumericLiteral` without checking that the operand is an `ast::Expr::Literal`, mis-highlighting `-x` as a numeric literal.
ExprCollector::collect_pat calls `bind_pat.name().expect("bind pat has a name")` on `FieldPatList::bind_pats()`, panicking on incomplete struct patterns produced by parser error recovery.

path_import_candidate only builds qualifier import candidates when `sema.resolve_path(&qualifier)` is `None`, missing `PathResolution::Def(ModuleDef::BuiltinType(_))` and preventing flyimport from importing primitive-shadowing modules like `core::str`.

AttrsWithOwner::source_map merges an outline module's definition-file inner attributes into the declaration file's `AttrSourceMap` via `map.merge(...)` under a single `file_id`, spilling inner doc injections into the parent module file.
Canonical projection normalization does not handle lifetime canonical variables in `CanonicalVarKinds`, failing to normalize projections containing lifetime variables.
FloatTypeWrapper parses and stores float literals as `f64` bit patterns (`f64::to_bits()`), causing double rounding when `f32` literals are later narrowed from `f64` to `f32`.

InferenceContext::infer_expr unconditionally sets `self.diverges = Diverges::Always` whenever an expression has type `!`, wrongly marking surrounding code as diverging for bare match arms and subexpressions.

insert_use_ replaces `is_inner_comment` with `is_comment` inside `scope_syntax.children_with_tokens().filter(...).last()` when a file has no imports, scanning past items and inserting new `use` statements after trailing comments at the end of the file instead of only after leading header comments.

ExprValidator::check_for_trailing_return assumes `statements.last()` of an `Expr::Block` is the final syntactic statement when `tail` is `None`, but `ExprCollector::collect_stmt` drops `ast::Stmt::Item` without pushing an entry into `statements`, falsely emitting `RemoveTrailingReturn` when an item declaration follows a `return` statement.

Adding `TypableDef::Type` and `type_for_type_alias` switched `Ty::from_hir_path` in `lower.rs` from `apply_substs` to `subst`, but left `InferenceContext::resolve_value_path` in `crates/ra_hir/src/ty/infer.rs` calling `type_for_def(...).apply_substs(substs)`, which overwrites the aliased type's substitution list with the type alias's generic arguments instead of substituting type parameters (corrupting arity and later tripping the `apply_substs` length assertion).

FindUsages::found_self_ty_name_ref checks `impl_.self_ty(self.sema.db) == *self_ty` directly instead of comparing underlying ADTs, missing `Self` references in `impl` blocks for generic ADTs because `Impl::self_ty` uses impl-scoped type parameter placeholders (or concrete type arguments) that do not equal `Adt::ty`'s definition-scoped type parameters.

InferenceContext::collect_fn calls `make_ty_with_mode(return_ty, ImplTraitLoweringMode::Opaque)`—which runs `normalize_associated_types_in`—before folding away `TyKind::OpaqueType` values that `TyLoweringContext` constructs with `generics.bound_vars_subst`, sending free `BoundVar`s inside projection obligations into canonicalization and normalizing against the opaque type instead of its inference variable.

annotations() sets `Annotation.range` to `value.syntax().text_range()` when `AnnotationLocation::AboveWholeItem` is configured, while `resolve_annotation()` still passes `annotation.range.start()` as the lookup offset to `goto_implementation` and `find_all_refs`, causing annotation resolution to fail (`data: None`) whenever leading doc comments or attributes precede the item's name.
